subject: Basic Applied Mathematics
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.1. Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
entries.learning_activity: Explore some advanced tenets of trigonometry (relationship of the secant, cosecant, and cotangent to the sine, cosine, and tangent, trigonometric identities: Pythagorean, compound and double angles)
teaching_learning_activities: Exploration: Guide students through geometrical drawings, measurements, graphs and geometrical animations to explore the basic tenets of trigonometry
entries.assessment: Some advanced tenets of trigonometry are well explored
entries.references: TIE, Basic Applied Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Use functions and calculus to solve problems in different contexts
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explore some advanced tenets of functions (Properties, Domain and Range and graphs of cubic functions, rational functions with a constant numerator and a linear equation in the denominator, logarithmic, and exponential functions)
teaching_learning_activities: Jig Saw: In groups assign students with a different types of functions to explore its tenets through concrete examples, graphs and function simulations and share the results through presentations
entries.assessment: Some advanced tenets of functions are well explored
resources: Mathematical software such as MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica
